QuestInfo.name: [Advice from General Maestro] Willful Will
QuestInfo.0: You'll need a strong will to pass the M-Forcer Action Exam! Talk to General Maestro for advice on how to get more willpower.
QuestInfo.1: General Maestro's advice on how to get more willpower? Eliminate monsters! He says to hunt monsters #bbetween 11 levels below you and 21 levels above you.#k
QuestInfo.2: You're received Willful Will from General Mastro!

0.0: You here for the M-Forcer Action Exam? Perfect timing, I was just looking for someone to-- Zzzzzzzz. *snort* What?! Right. You'll need three things to become an M-Forcer: courage, will, and faith! And you'll need them in abundance!
0.1: In fact, all you have to do is-- Zzzzzzz. *snort* What?! Right. You need #bcourage, will, and faith,#k and tons of it! Prove to me you have Willful Will. That means you have to have endurance! That means you have to be able to spend days in the field without a wink of slee-- Zzzzzz.

yes.0: Defeat monsters to prove your willpower! Remember, #bonly monsters that are between 11 levels below you and 21 levels above you count!#k Now get out there and kick some as-- Zzzzzz.

1.0: Your endurance astounds me, and not just because I lack the willpower to stay awake for more than 3 minutes at a time. When the Omega Sector was formed, my M-Forcers showed astounding willpower, battling the aliens with our bare fists at times!

yes.0: Will doesn't just appear, you know? You have to earn it! That's what Willful Will is all about!

mob.0: Defeat monsters to prove your willpower! Remember, #bonly monsters that are between 11 levels below you and 21 levels above you count!#k Now get out there and kick some as-- Zzzzzz.
